_note: Hand-written reference IR for tests/variants/brief-r6.md + api-r6.json (our own generalisation test, written independently: car finance, clean specification, up to three agreements). Distinctive: renamed call variables plus inbound_number used inside fixed sentences; three identity questions with month-first dates (MDY), fourth wrong answer ends the check, the first refusal closes; Mon-Sat business days, holidays given with weekday names, week runs Sunday-Saturday (week_start 6); three bands, Reminder in calendar days with 0 attempts; ladder inverted vs the kit (attempt 1 full on the deadline, attempt 2 floor at end of week, clipped to the deadline); callback within the next 3 business days, never today, two alternative asks; two create_promise retries; hyphenated close codes vs underscore note categories; a distinct paid disposition that DOES carry a reason (reported-paid / paid-before-call). stage_rules are left empty (free text, ignored by ir_diff).

opening.first_sentence: Hello, this is Halberd Motor Finance's automated assistant. This call is recorded.

questions.ask: Could you tell me your date of birth?
Thank you. What is the postcode of your home address?
And what are the last three digits of the customer reference number on your statements?

identity.swapped_instruction: Ask the customer to say the date of birth again with the month as a word. That retry is not a wrong answer.
identity.failed_message: I'm sorry, I can't go any further on this call. Please call us on <inbound_number>.
identity.refusal_explanation: These checks make sure I only discuss the account with its holder.

debt_intro: I'm calling from Halberd's customer accounts team because payments on your account are overdue.
product_sentence: Your <spoken> is <arrears> pounds in arrears and <days_in_arrears> days overdue.
first_ask_single: Are you able to pay the full arrears today?
first_ask_multi: Are you able to pay all of these in full today?

recording.after_promise_sentence: You will receive an email confirming this arrangement today.

fixed_sentences.deceased: I'm very sorry to hear that. I won't take up any more of your time.
fixed_sentences.robot: Yes, I'm an automated assistant working for Halberd Motor Finance.
fixed_sentences.scam: You can check this call is genuine by hanging up and calling us on <inbound_number>.
fixed_sentences.paid: Thank you. Payments can take up to three business days to reach your agreement.
fixed_sentences.farewell: Thank you for your time today. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: Halberd's week runs from Sunday to Saturday.
business days are Monday to Saturday. Sunday is never a business day.
12 calendar days after today; if that day is not a business day, the last business day before it
a date of birth said only in numbers ("four, seven, ninety", "04/07/1990") is month, then day, then year
Up to three wrong answers in total are allowed across the three questions; the fourth ends the check
one of the next three business days after today; never today
asks for another time, at most twice
| 1 | Arrears, Pre-default | the full arrears | the agreement's deadline |
| 2 | Pre-default | the floor | the end of this week; if today is that day, the end of next week; if that date is after the deadline, the deadline |
A failed call is tried again, up to two more times.

unmapped_rules: After get_account and before stating the arrears, say word for word: "Before we go on, free and impartial debt advice is available from independent charities, and using it will not change how we treat you."

A promise dated today can be taken only before 17:00 by call_datetime. From 17:00 on, today is not available: the first question asks about the next business day instead ("Are you able to pay the full arrears by <weekday day month>?"), and a customer who offers today is offered the next business day.
Each date in a read-back is said with its weekday, for example "Saturday 24 October".
